AlphaItem.title: AlphaItem
AlphaItem.description:
A live ALPHA list entry. The underlying TickerAnalysis is stored separately
(`analyses` table) and powers the detail view via the existing Ticker components.

AlphaReason.title: AlphaReason
AlphaReason.description: One structured, reviewable reason behind an alpha verdict.

AlphaVerdict.title: AlphaVerdict
AlphaVerdict.description: agent2/agent3 output: is this a genuine alpha opportunity, why, and what it saw.

DowngradedItem.title: DowngradedItem
DowngradedItem.description: A formerly-alpha name that no longer qualifies.

GapNote.title: GapNote
GapNote.description:
A textbook (non-common) price gap worth the trader's attention. Common gaps are
suppressed (they add nothing).

KeyLevel.title: KeyLevel
KeyLevel.description: A price point worth watching on an alpha name (resistance / support / a high).

LongPosture.title: LongPosture
LongPosture.description: What the regime implies for new long swing exposure.

RegimeChart.title: RegimeChart
RegimeChart.description: The actual time-series behind a consideration, so the dashboard can draw it.

RegimeMetric.title: RegimeMetric
RegimeMetric.description: One book-grounded reading (e.g. distribution-day count, Power Trend on/off).

RegimePillar.title: RegimePillar
RegimePillar.description: A cluster of related metrics with an aggregate status (one of the 5 pillars).

RegimeSnapshot.title: RegimeSnapshot
RegimeSnapshot.description:
The full market-conditions read: the input data (charts + metrics) AND the
conclusion (mood/state/posture/narrative). Persisted whole so the dashboard
redraws entirely from the DB with no re-fetch.

RegimeState.title: RegimeState
RegimeState.description: Overall market state — the IBD/Weinstein-style ladder for a LONG book.

ScreenFactor.title: ScreenFactor
ScreenFactor.description: One pre-screen reading shown on a scanner candidate row.

ScreenerCandidate.title: ScreenerCandidate
ScreenerCandidate.description:
A scanner hit — a ticker that MIGHT have a good trade (cheap pre-screen, not yet
the full agent analysis). The user selects these to push into the alpha pipeline.
Once evaluated, it carries the agent's verdict (reasons + the inputs it saw).

SynthesisRead.title: SynthesisRead
SynthesisRead.description: The cross-timeframe fusion — the big-picture call over all the per-TF theses.

TimeframeThesis.title: TimeframeThesis
TimeframeThesis.description:
What the AI analyst concluded for ONE timeframe — its own pattern call, the exact
levels (verified via the geometry tools), the shapes to draw, and an audit trail.
